name: File locations
description: Windows MDM settings in the File locations category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Projects (User)
properties.description:
Specifies the default location in the computer system for saving and opening projects.

If you enable this policy setting, the location first appears in the Open and Save As dialog box.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the users default for this setting is followed.

properties.name: User Templates (User)
properties.description:
Specifies the default location in the computer system for saving and opening workgroup templates.

If you enable this policy setting, the location first appears in the Open and Save As dialog box.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the users default for this setting is followed.
